entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Manṣūr Mauhūb al-Jawālīqī was an Arab grammarian born in Baghdād, where he studied philology under Khātib al-Tibrizī and became famous for his handwriting. In his later years he acted as Imam to the Abbāsid caliph Al-Muqtafi.
